#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

vector<double> fftRealImag(vector<double>& a, vector<double>& b, bool invert) {
    int n = a.size();
    for (int i = 1, j = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int bitMask = n >> 1;
        for (; (j & bitMask) != 0; bitMask >>= 1) {
            j &= ~bitMask;
        }
        j |= bitMask;
        if (i < j) {
            swap(a[i], a[j]);
            swap(b[i], b[j]);
        }
    }
    for (int len = 2; len <= n; len <<= 1) {
        double angle = 2 * M_PI / len * (invert ? -1 : 1);
        double c = cos(angle);
        double s = sin(angle);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i += len) {
            double wReal = 1, wImag = 0;
            for (int j = 0; j < len / 2; j++) {
                double u = a[i + j], v = a[i + j + len / 2] * wReal + b[i + j + len / 2] * wImag;
                a[i + j] = u + v;
                a[i + j + len / 2] = u - v;
                double tempWReal = wReal * c - wImag * s;
                wImag = wImag * c + wReal * s;
                wReal = tempWReal;
            }
        }
    }
    if (invert) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            a[i] /= n;
            b[i] /= n;
        }
    }
    return {a.begin(), a.end()};
}

vector<int> polyConv(const vector<int>& a, const vector<int>& b, int mod) {
    int size = 1;
    while (size < (int)(a.size() + b.size() - 1))
        size <<= 1;
    vector<double> A(size, 0), B(size, 0);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < a.size(); i++) {
        int x = ((a[i] % mod) + mod) % mod;
        A[i] = (x & ((1 << 15) - 1)) + ((x >> 15) * 1e-6);
    }
    for (size_t i = 0; i < b.size(); i++) {
        int x = ((b[i] % mod) + mod) % mod;
        B[i] = (x & ((1 << 15) - 1)) + ((x >> 15) * 1e-6);
    }
    vector<double> FA(size), FB(size);
    fftRealImag(A, B, false);
    FA = A;
    FB = B;
    fftRealImag(FA, FB, true);
    vector<int> result(a.size() + b.size() - 1);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < result.size(); i++) {
        long long aa = llround(FA[i]);
        long long bb = llround(FB[i]);
        long long val = (aa + ((bb % mod) << 15)) % mod;
        result[i] = (int)val;
    }
    return result;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int totalTestCases = 1; // Only one input case expected
    for (int _ = 0; _ < totalTestCases; _++) {
        int n, k;
        cin >> n >> k;
        vector<int> v(10, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int x;
            cin >> x;
            v[x] = 1;
        }
        vector<int> currentPoly = {1};
        int exp = n / 2;
        const int mod = 998244353;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if (exp & 1) {
                currentPoly = polyConv(currentPoly, v, mod);
            }
            v = polyConv(v, v, mod);
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        long long answer = 0;
        for (int val : currentPoly) {
            answer = (answer + (long long)val * val) % mod;
        }
        cout << answer << "\n";
    }
    return 0;
}
